name: fm-threads
description: Firstmate thread board for Claude Code: a two-row bar above the prompt showing the last response's date and time and every open conversation thread, with a reserved slot at the far right that Firstmate Calm fills with its working animation. The model keeps the threads through the `thread` tool. Activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.
